title: Resident Doctors’ Stir In Kashmir Spreads To District Hospitals

ai.summary: Resident doctors in Jammu and Kashmir joined a protest demanding pay parity with central medical institutions, with the agitation now spanning multiple district hospitals and government medical colleges.

facts.claim: agitation by postgraduate (PG) and Senior Resident doctors demanding enhancement of stipends and pay parity with premier medical institutions
facts.quote: Srinagar- The agitation by postgraduate (PG) and Senior Resident doctors demanding enhancement of stipends and pay parity with premier medical institutions intensified across Jammu and Kashmir on Tuesday, with resident doctors from several Government Medical Colleges and district hospitals joining the protests.

facts.claim: agitation entered its fifth consecutive day at Government Medical College (GMC) Srinagar and sixth day at GMC Jammu
facts.quote: The agitation entered its fifth consecutive day at Government Medical College (GMC) Srinagar and sixth day at GMC Jammu, as doctors continued to demand revision of their existing pay structure, removal of disparities and a uniform policy across medical institutions in the Union Territory.

facts.claim: AIMSA and Resident Doctors’ Associations (RDAs) said the demands were aimed at securing financial parity for PG and Senior Resident doctors with their counterparts at SKIMS Srinagar, AIIMS Jammu and other premier central medical institutions
facts.quote: The Association of Indian Medical Students and Resident Doctors (AIMSA), along with Resident Doctors’ Associations (RDAs), said the demands were aimed at securing financial parity for PG and Senior Resident doctors with their counterparts at SKIMS Srinagar, AIIMS Jammu and other premier central medical institutions.

facts.claim: AIMSA has placed several demands including replacement of the existing 6th Pay Commission-based structure with 7th Central Pay Commission Level 10 for PG residents, along with Dearness Allowance (DA) and House Rent Allowance (HRA)
facts.quote: AIMSA has placed several demands before the government, including replacement of the existing 6th Pay Commission-based structure with 7th Central Pay Commission Level 10 for PG residents, along with Dearness Allowance (DA) and House Rent Allowance (HRA).

facts.claim: AIMSA has also sought an enhancement of the basic pay of Senior Residents to Rs 67,700, at par with their counterparts at SKIMS Srinagar and other central medical institutions, besides 20 per cent Non-Practising Allowance (NPA) for PG and Senior Resident doctors
facts.quote: The association has also sought an enhancement of the basic pay of Senior Residents to Rs 67,700, at par with their counterparts at SKIMS Srinagar and other central medical institutions, besides 20 per cent Non-Practising Allowance (NPA) for PG and Senior Resident doctors.

facts.claim: Resident doctors at Sub-District Hospital Sopore staged a protest, demanding equal pay and recognition
facts.quote: Resident doctors at Sub-District Hospital Sopore also staged a protest, demanding equal pay and recognition.

facts.claim: Dr Yaser Fayaz from District Hospital Kulgam said resident doctors there had joined the indefinite strike from November 23 over disparities in stipends
facts.quote: Dr Yaser Fayaz from District Hospital Kulgam said resident doctors there had joined the indefinite strike from November 23 over disparities in stipends.

facts.claim: At JLNM Hospital, Dr Ravi and Dr Zoha Suzain highlighted the disparity faced by DNB residents, saying they were currently receiving a stipend of only Rs 48,000
facts.quote: Dr Ravi and Dr Zoha Suzain highlighted the disparity faced by DNB residents, saying they were currently receiving a stipend of only Rs 48,000.

ai.background_note: Resident doctors in Jammu and Kashmir are protesting for pay parity with central medical institutions, with the agitation now spanning multiple district hospitals and government medical colleges.
